subject: Logic
title: Appeal to Pity
description: Learn Appeal to Pity in one minute.

hook.text: "I know I cheated on the test, but I'll lose my scholarship." Sad? Yes. Relevant? No.

buildup.text: Appeal to pity uses compassion to justify a conclusion that emotions alone can't support.

discovery.text: Courtrooms see this often: a defendant's tough childhood used to excuse unrelated wrongdoing.

twist.text: Pity is a valid human response. It just doesn't substitute for evidence in a logical argument.

climax.text: Separate sympathy from analysis. You can feel sorry for someone and still evaluate facts clearly.

quiz.question: What does the appeal to pity replace?
